experiment: TopK certification over the BIRD Mini-Dev 500 (replay of recorded agent SQL; no model calls), v2: total-order and boundary-strict routes

protocol.agent_sql_source: external_workloads/bird/agent_run/q*.json (field sql; run 185542, recorded in eval-bird-agent.json)
protocol.execution: per ranked page, one sqlite read transaction (sql_snapshot.consistent_page_and_count): the statement, then the rank-boundary probe (in its `between` hook), then COUNT(*) of Q'; 600 s progress-handler ceiling; cells normalized by run_bird_agent.norm_cell
protocol.claim: TopK(S = delivered rows, key/dir = the statement's ORDER BY as written, k = its LIMIT)
protocol.candidate_domain: the statement with its outer LIMIT removed (sqlglot, sqlite dialect); inner LIMITs kept
protocol.order_total_rule: the ORDER BY list contains every column of a unique non-null key of the single base table in FROM: rowid/_rowid_/oid on rowid tables, or the PRIMARY KEY when it cannot hold NULL (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, WITHOUT ROWID, or all key columns NOT NULL); joins, GROUP BY, derived sources, compound queries and DISTINCT over an unprojected key are not established
protocol.delivery_complete: page shorter than k (candidates exhausted) or COUNT(*) of Q' equals the page length
protocol.outer_offset: LIMIT with nonzero OFFSET is not a top-k page (a rank window) and is not instantiated
protocol.tie_probe: diagnostic only: Q' re-projected onto its ORDER BY keys, LIMIT k+1; adjacent equal key tuples are ties
protocol.boundary_rule: rank-boundary strictness at k: one statement over Q' adding ROW_NUMBER() and RANK() OVER the recorded ORDER BY; strict iff min(|Q'|, k+1) <= k or the row at position k+1 has RANK k+1 (the engine's own peer test, so its NULL placement and collation); DISTINCT and compound statements are not probed (not strict)
protocol.claims: per page, TopK as a sequence claim (route total_order) and as a set claim (route boundary_strict, also served by total_order); a page counts once, under the first route that certifies
protocol.seconds: page = BEGIN + data_version + statement; boundary_probe = the extra statement; count_and_commit = COUNT(*) of Q' + data_version recheck + COMMIT

order: CAST(SUBSTRING(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1, INSTR(q3, '.') - INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTRING(q3, INSTR(q3, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
